description: Source code for the JPEG image decoder class 'JPEGSource' in Android's media framework, handling JPEG parsing, reading, and format retrieval.

classes.name: JPEGSource
classes.description: A class for decoding JPEG images from a data source, extracting image format and dimensions.

methods.name: parseJPEG
methods.description: Parses the JPEG data to extract width and height by scanning JPEG markers.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes buffer group and prepares for reading JPEG data.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Releases resources associated with JPEG reading.

methods.name: getFormat
methods.description: Returns metadata about the JPEG image, including MIME type, width, height, and size.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads JPEG data into a buffer, supporting seeking.
